emotional_tone: High-end luxury jewelry atelier, sleek obsidian & 18K gold aesthetics with realistic 3D display forms
theme: Dark Showroom (#0B0B0C base, #D4AF37 gold accents, #161618 velvet)

hand_forearm_redesign.problem: Currently uses disconnected cylinder forearm + rounded box palm + floating capsule fingers.
hand_forearm_redesign.solution_code_mesh: Construct a smooth continuous anatomical hand mesh using Three.js ExtrudeGeometry / LatheGeometry / Parametric / Tube curves or merged CSG/Group blending.
hand_forearm_redesign.forearm_spec: Gradual tapered anatomical forearm using CylinderGeometry with length 0.9, top radius 0.125, bottom radius 0.175, with smooth transitional bevel mesh to wrist joint.
hand_forearm_redesign.palm_thenar_spec: Replace BoxGeometry with an organic palm shape using ExtrudeGeometry along a soft palm outline (with thumb thenar eminence swelling and hypothenar mound), radius corner rounding 0.08.
hand_forearm_redesign.finger_joints: Connect proximal, middle, and distal phalanges with joint knuckles (small sphere geometries at joints) to eliminate gaps, set soft resting curl angles: Index (-0.15 rad), Middle (-0.1 rad), Ring (-0.18 rad), Little (-0.22 rad), Thumb gently opposed at 45 degrees.
hand_forearm_redesign.skin_material_update: MeshPhysicalMaterial with subsurface scattering approximation: color '#E8DFD3', roughness 0.38, clearcoat 0.15, clearcoatRoughness 0.25, metalness 0.02, envMapIntensity 1.2.

bust_neck_redesign.problem: Currently uses flat lathed bust shape without defined collarbones, sternum, or elegant neck curve.
bust_neck_redesign.solution_code_mesh: Refine bust LatheGeometry profile vector sequence to add anatomical contours: delicate neck narrowing (r=0.125 at mid-neck), collarbone ridge flare (x=0.28, y=0.42), shoulder slope taper, and soft pedestal transition.
bust_neck_redesign.bust_material_update: Velvet MeshStandardMaterial: color '#121214', roughness 0.98, metalness 0.0, with subtle rim lighting highlight or sheen map.

wrist.description: Macro close-up on wrist joint and forearm stack, highlighting bangle/bracelet fit.

ring.description: Intimate finger focus framing rings across all 5 finger anchors with zero distortion.

neck.description: High-fashion portrait view centering the collarbone and draped necklace curve.

studio_lighting.key_spotlight: Warm showroom spot at [2.5, 4.5, 2.5], color '#FFF5E0', intensity 120, penumbra 0.5 with high-res soft shadows.
studio_lighting.fill_light: Gold ambient rim fill at [-3.5, 2.0, -2.0], color '#D4AF37', intensity 45.
studio_lighting.sparkle_glint: Point light at [0.5, 1.5, 1.8], color '#FFFFFF', intensity 15 to capture diamond/gem facets.

headings.font_family: Cormorant Garamond, Playfair Display, or serif fallback
